value.rationale: The precise distinguished-hub finite heterogeneous social star has a complete stationary law. The result establishes a nonstandard mesoscopic intermittency regime: dissent occurs with probability ~log(m)/m but contributes order-one mean and order-m variance; conditioned on dissent it spans sizes logarithmically uniformly. This addresses why mean disagreement statistics can misrepresent typical observed consensus and informs finite stochastic-network model selection.
